text: Hello, boys and girls.Nice to see you again.Please get your student's book and worksheet ready.In this period, we'll go on with the letter from John, and go deeper into it.We know John wrote a letter to Mei, because he would like to be Mei's pen friend, but how did he know Mei was looking for pen friends?He saw Mei's name in Pen Friends magazine, so Pen Friends magazine provides information of people who are looking for pen friends.Besides Pen Friends magazine, there are many other resources.For example, in Book 7A, Mr.Hu introduced an organization to his class called Pen Friends International.Also, there are a few websites such as PenPal World, Global Pen Friends, which can help us find people we want to write to.Some newspapers and magazines can help people find pen friends as well.When John introduced himself, he told Mei his name, age, height, hairstyle.What else did he tell Mei about himself?He also introduced his hobbies.What are his hobbies?Playing chess, skiing, playing table tennis.When he introduced his hobbies, what did he write?My hobby is playing chess.I'm keen on sports.I enjoy skiing and playing table tennis.John used different words or phrases to tell Mei he likes doing something.It can not only avoid reputation but also enrich his language.避免重複,豐富语言Can you think of some other words or phrases to express like?For example, we can use be interested in or be fond of to replace like.John also told Mei his ambition.What is it?My ambition is to be an architect or maybe an engineer.Can you think of some other words or phrases to talk about ambitions?I want to beI would like to beI dream of being and so onIn John's letter, he introduced himself first.When he introduced his name, Jonathan Chen, he addedYou can call me John.Why did John tell Mei that she could call him John?John is the short form of Jonathan.It's easy to call and it is usually used among friends.By asking Mei to call him John, he wanted to establish a close relationship with Mei,so that they can get to know each other as quickly as possible.Besides himself, John also introduced his family.And when he introduced his family, how did he tell Mei what job his family members did?He wrote,My dad owns a Chinese restaurant nearby.And my mom works in a college.I have a brother.His name is Willie.He is at university in London.He is studying to be an accountant.By providing specific information, John drew a vivid picture of his family,so that Mei would be interested in his family.Was John interested in Mei's family?Why do you think so?He asked Mei two questions.How many people are there in your family?What do they do?By asking these two questions, John showed interest in Mei's family.It seems that two friends are chatting with each other face to face.He tried to interact with Mei.By asking questions in the letter, he created an interactive atmosphere.Are there any other questions John asked in his letter?It is beautiful, isn't it?What does it refer to?It refers to his school.Why did John add, isn't it?By adding, isn't it?It can also arouse Mei's interest in his school.It can also arouse Mei's interest in his school and also create an interactive atmosphere.How did John start his letter and end his letter?I saw your name in Pen Friends magazine, and I would like to be your pen friend.I hope you will write to me soon and tell me all about yourself.John told Mei the purpose of writing the letter at the very beginning and gave his wishes at the end of the letter.What do you think of John's way to start and end his letter?He is polite, friendly and sincere.He wants to show politeness and sincerity by saying,I would like to, I hope you.It's important for us to keep manners in mind when writing a letter.John told many facts about himself.For example, he told Mei his hobby was playing chess.Actually, we can infer some information from this fact.根據事實進行推測。For example, maybe he is very clever.And we can also say, he is probably very clever.Probably means maybe.Please read off me.ProbablyWhat other information can you infer from his hobby?He is probably interested in math.Kids, pay attention.When we infer something from the facts,make sure our inferences are reasonable and logical.推測要合理,符合邏輯。Here are some statements about John.Read a letter again and find facts that tell you they are probably true.The first one has been done for you.That's exercise D3 on page 6 of your student's book.The second one.The third one.The fourth one.The fifth one.The sixth one.The seventh one.Have you finished?Let's check.Number two.His dad probably enjoys food.I think it is true.Because his dad owns a Chinese restaurant.Number three.I agree that he is probably healthy, because he is keen on sports.The last one.I think he will probably go to university after he leaves school, because his ambition is to be an architect or maybe an engineer.Now, please find a fact about John and his dad and make possible inferences.It's task one on your worksheet.Let's share some of my students' ideas.What about you, Nina?John's dad owns a Chinese restaurant.I think he probably has a good taste of food, and maybe he makes a lot of money because Chinese restaurants are very popular among foreigners.But he is probably very busy and tired, because running a restaurant is not an easy job.Your inferences are reasonable and logical.Well done.John told me many facts about himself, his family and his school.Of course, may can infer more from these facts.At the end of the letter, John wrote, I hope you will write to me soon and tell me all about yourself.Do you think May will write back to John soon?Why or why not?If May writes to John, what will she write in her letter?Do you think May will write to John soon?If May writes to John soon, what will she write in her letter?I think May will write back to John because John wrote the letter politely and sincerely.Besides, in his letter, John introduced himself in detail.He drew a vivid picture of his life in the UK.It can make May interested in him.And John asked several questions in his letter.I think May will be glad to answer these questions in her letter.Nina, could you share your ideas?If May writes to John, I think she will also introduce herself as John did in his letter.And I think she will also write about the topic like her family, her school and so on.Of course, she will answer the questions John asked in his letter.What's your opinion, everyone?You can share with your classmates and teachers.Today, we read John's letter again and focus more on its language.We know that when writing a letter, we can use different words or phrases to express the same meaning to enrich your language.We should be polite and sincere when writing to others.And based on some facts, we can make inferences.But attention, inferences should be reasonable and logical.This is your homework.This is the end of today's class.See you next time.Bye bye.
